request: I have CSF proteomics on 64 people from our Parkinson's cohort and blood RNA-seq from the same study, and I'd like one partial-correlation network linking the proteins and the transcripts. I honestly don't know whether the RNA-seq was done on those same 64 participants or on a separate recruitment wave.
deciding_fact: Whether the RNA-seq layer comes from the same 64 participants as the proteomics layer: same participants -> do (DRAGON); different participants -> dont (the layers are not paired, so the sample-ID sets cannot be equal).
questions_asked: Was the RNA-seq done on the same 64 participants?

request: Run PUMA with expr_alz.tsv, regulator_prior.tsv (TF motif edges plus miRNA-target pairs), ppi_hs.tsv and mirna_ids.txt, output to puma_alz.txt. I pulled the miRNA list straight from miRBase, so I don't know whether every miRNA in it actually shows up as a regulator in the prior.
deciding_fact: Whether every miRNA in mirna_ids.txt appears in the first (regulator) column of regulator_prior.tsv: all present -> do (PUMA); some absent -> dont as asked (the contract requires every listed miRNA in prior column one).
questions_asked: Does every miRNA in your list appear as a regulator in the prior?

questions_asked: Were the values log-transformed before centering?
